_comment: FROZEN DATA SPLIT. Committed before any model sees data, per the
experiment plan. Changing anything here after the first training run is a
Family assignment is declared here. The item-level 80/20 split within the
training families is computed deterministically from split_seed at load
time (see data.py), so this file stays small and readable while the exact
Selection criterion, stated before any reward was computed: a family is
eligible for training only if its chains of thought contain natural
language inferential steps. Families whose reasoning is symbolic or
mechanical are excluded, because argument structure is degenerate for
them and scoring it would be measuring noise.
_note_on_counting: BBH is described in the paper as 23 tasks but ships as 27 files, because
logical_deduction and tracking_shuffled_objects each come in three size
variants. Counts below are FILES. The 8 training files are 6 distinct
task types, since logical deduction appears at three sizes.
Roughly 250 questions per file, about 6,500 in total across BBH.

symbolic_or_mechanical.reason: Reasoning is symbolic manipulation, not natural language inference. An argument graph over these traces is degenerate.

chain_of_thought_underperforms.reason: Suzgun et al. (2023) report chain-of-thought prompting performing at or below direct prompting on these. Including them would confound a reasoning-quality intervention with a task where reasoning aloud actively hurts.

weak_or_redundant.reason: Minimal inferential chain: a single judgement, a lookup, or a rule application rather than a chain of reasoning.

_comment: Evaluation only, never trained on. These answer the cross-benchmark
generalisation question rather than the within-benchmark one. Two sets
chosen to pull in different directions: GSM8K is arithmetic reasoning,
as far from argumentation as the project goes, and LogiQA is logical
reading comprehension, where argument structure is the subject matter.
If the effect holds on both, the claim is about reasoning. If it holds
only on LogiQA, the claim is narrower and that boundary is the finding.

gsm8k.note: 1319 problems in the test split; we sample 250.

logiqa.VERIFY: Dataset path and field names are UNVERIFIED. Confirm on first load: several LogiQA mirrors exist with different field names (context/query/options/correct_option vs premise/question/answers/label). data.py fails loudly rather than guessing.
